definition.description: Curated byte-preserving import from a committed legacy Git tree. Repository controls and an exact Rust toolchain are reconstructed; golden-sensitive fixtures and inherited Rust formatting debt remain byte-identical and are governed by source-bound exact exception baselines. Legacy deployment, release orchestration, CI, homelab harness material, generated build/cache path segments, and movable legacy Rust toolchain declarations are never inherited.
repairs: exclude legacy deploy tree including H1 fixed-host deployment/test harness
exclude legacy release orchestration scripts with unresolved inherited dependencies
include canonical root Cargo workspace and lockfile
reconstruct root README instead of importing stale release documentation
deny generated/build/cache directory names by path segment at repository root and nested depths
stage with normal gitignore semantics instead of force-adding generated files
hash only tracked baseline files and validate destination remotes before materialization
preserve all imported source blobs byte-for-byte and verify each destination hash against the immutable import manifest
preserve accepted Phase 9D fixture bytes and bind the 14 inherited whitespace warnings to exact source file hashes
exclude the movable legacy stable Rust toolchain declaration, reconstruct Rust 1.97.1, and validate the exact inherited rustfmt drift in an isolated temporary copy without rewriting repository source
